params.body:
Intelligence opens the Observatory to read (#226), but gentells.com had no link to it: a reader had to know the address from the set-password mail.

- The nav shows "Observatory" next to "Your plan" for signed-in accounts whose plan opens the Observatory, and for team accounts. It also appears as a button in the mobile menu.
- Hidden for a blocked account, for any other plan, and for visitors.
- The address is `config('gentells.observatory_url')`: `OBSERVATORY_URL` when set, otherwise https://observatory.gentells.com.

Tests: `ObservatoryLinkTest`. Suite 473/474; BuildStampTest fails in a worktree checkout, as always.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
params.title: Nav links to the Observatory for Intelligence and the team
